errors.constructor: Construct a `MakeError` with the given message and `code`.
MakeError.constructor: Construct a `MakeError` with the given message and `code`.
BuildOptions.build: Path to the build tree (default `'build'`, unset when `preset` is given).
BuildOptions.cwd: Working directory the build runs in (default the process working directory).
BuildOptions.parallel: Number of parallel jobs; `0` lets the build system decide (default `0`).
BuildOptions.stdio: Standard I/O configuration passed to the CMake subprocess.
BuildOptions.target: The target to build (default all targets).
GenerateOptions.arch: Architecture to build for (default the host architecture).
GenerateOptions.build: Path to the build tree (default `'build'`, unset when `preset` is given).
GenerateOptions.cache: Reuse the build variable cache; set to `false` to configure fresh (default `true`).
GenerateOptions.cwd: Working directory the generation runs in (default the process working directory).
GenerateOptions.define: Build variable cache entries to create or update, as `<var>[:<type>]=<value>` strings (default `[]`).
GenerateOptions.environment: The environment to build for (default none).
GenerateOptions.platform: Operating system platform to build for (default the host platform).
GenerateOptions.stdio: Standard I/O configuration passed to the CMake subprocess.
GenerateOptions.withDebugSymbols: Configure a release build with debug symbols (default `false`).
GenerateOptions.withMinimalSize: Configure a release build with minimal size (default `false`).
InstallOptions.component: The component to install (default all components).
InstallOptions.cwd: Working directory the install runs in (default the process working directory).
InstallOptions.link: Symlink rather than copy the installed files (default `false`).
InstallOptions.stdio: Standard I/O configuration passed to the CMake subprocess.
TestOptions.cwd: Working directory the tests run in (default the process working directory).
TestOptions.parallel: Number of parallel jobs; a negative value lets the runner decide (default `-1`).
TestOptions.stdio: Standard I/O configuration passed to the CMake subprocess.
